LIBRENG_SAKAY.name: Municipality of Mexico
LIBRENG_SAKAY.reference: Transport-strike temporary Libreng Sakay advisory naming Mexico Bayan in front of Sta. Monica Parish Church.
LIBRENG_SAKAY.supports: Official temporary transport pickup/drop context at the named area.
LIBRENG_SAKAY.limits: Does not establish a permanent everyday jeepney terminal, current normal service, or San Juan/Arayat bay. Event hours are not regular service hours.

RA11314.name: Republic Act No. 11314, Student Fare Discount Act
RA11314.reference: Sections 3–5: covered students/public transport and discount on domestic regular fares, subject to eligibility and documentation requirements.
RA11314.supports: 20% student discount policy for eligible public transportation regular fares.
RA11314.limits: Does not establish any route-specific regular fare. Remembered student payments cannot establish the current regular fare.

nodes.name: Pampanga State University Mexico Campus – Front Waiting Area
nodes.notes: Commuters report jeepneys and tricycles waiting directly in front of PSU Mexico Campus. The university reportedly provides waiting space; formal terminal status is unconfirmed. Team reports Street View review on 2026-09-23 confirming the campus-front road/waiting area. Also reported as the normal return drop-off from San Fernando/Robinsons. One shared node represents both uses. Node type is a research classification, not proof of formal designation. Exact GPS, pickup/dropoff behavior and legal designation need on-site confirmation.

nodes.name: Mexico Bayan – Sta. Monica Parish Church Transfer Area
nodes.notes: Local testimony reports that PSU/San Juan passengers may alight in Mexico Bayan and transfer to a San Fernando-bound jeep. Team reports remote Street View review of the Sta. Monica Parish Church/Mexico Bayan area. Official 2026 Libreng Sakay evidence supports temporary pickup/drop activity here, not a permanent formal everyday terminal. Exact permanent loading location and the Arayat-jeep boarding point are unresolved.

routes.route_name: Arayat – San Fernando via Sta. Ana, Mexico
routes.notes: PAMANA internal research identifier; not an official LTFRB route code. LPTRP Table 16 lists this through-route. Local testimony suggests passengers may use a segment after transferring in Mexico Bayan. Exact boarding point, direction, SM/Rob alighting behavior, fare, timetable and current availability remain unresolved. No active fleet count inferred.

variant_note: Direct SM/Rob service reported by regular commuter, but later local evidence indicates a transfer-via-Mexico-Bayan journey is also commonly used. Current service pattern and relative availability remain unresolved. No universal availability is asserted; the return direction is separately modeled. Reported dispatch and approximate campus service end are contextual testimony, not a verified schedule for either variant.

reported_outbound_locality_sequence.interpretation: Earlier commuter testimony; candidate waypoints/landmarks only. Pickup/dropoff behavior is unknown, so no RouteVariantStops are created.

reported_operations.scope: Campus/waiting-area testimony; not established independently for every direct or transfer leg.
reported_operations.service_end_meaning: Campus jeepneys are reported usually unavailable from around 4:30 PM onward; not a guaranteed scheduled last trip.

fare_policy.storage: Documentation/policy only; no FareRule or computed fare.
fare_policy.reason: Current regular fares for each leg remain unverified; remembered student fares and road distances are insufficient.

road_reference.scope: Team-reported review between Robinsons Starmills and PSU Mexico Campus; geographic road-reference only.
road_reference.restriction: Car navigation is not public-transport route evidence; do not import its geometry or derive fares from road distance.
